blogs.title: How to build a consistent NDA preparation plan
blogs.excerpt: A practical weekly rhythm for balancing concepts, practice and revision.
blogs.body:
A strong NDA preparation plan is built on consistency. Start with a weekly cycle that gives every subject a focused block, then protect time for mock tests and error review.

Begin each week by choosing three measurable goals. Review your progress at the weekend and adjust the next cycle around the topics that need more attention.
